cabinCategories.description: Queen Elizabeth interior stateroom — impeccably appointed with Cunard's signature style, White Star Service, and Britannia restaurant dining.
Ocean view stateroom with large window — watch Alaska's magnificent scenery from the traditional comfort of a Cunard stateroom.
Balcony stateroom with private outdoor space — an essential feature on Alaska's many scenic cruising days.
Grills Suite with exclusive Queens Grill restaurant access, butler service, priority embarkation, and the most elevated service at sea.

exclusions: Queens Grill and Princess Grill restaurants (Grills-class only)
inclusions: All meals in Britannia restaurant and Lido buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Cunard's Queen Elizabeth begins a grand 10-night Alaska voyage with all the ceremony and tradition that only Cunard can deliver.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A leisurely day at sea aboard one of the most storied ocean liners afloat. White-glove afternoon tea, the grand ballroom, and the Queen's Room beckon.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Coastal Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's spectacular capital — extended time allows for a helicopter glacier tour AND a whale watching excursion. Mendenhall Glacier is particularly impressive when seen from the air.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Klondike Gold Rush National Historic Park. The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway's dramatic ascent above tree line to the Canadian border is one of North America's finest journeys.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through the grandeur of Glacier Bay — National Park Rangers board Queen Elizabeth to narrate the remarkable glacial landscape.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Russian Alaska's legacy lives on in Sitka's onion-domed cathedral and Tlingit totem poles. Extended port time allows thorough exploration of this unique cultural destination.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: A graceful day at sea through the Inside Passage. Afternoon tea in the Queen's Room and evening dancing in the ballroom define Cunard's timeless Alaska experience.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage

portsOfCall.description: The world's largest collection of standing totem poles and Creek Street's vibrant history highlight this beloved Alaska port.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: A fitting final port of call on a Cunard voyage — refined, British, and utterly charming. High tea at the Fairmont Empress pays homage to Victoria's imperial heritage.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

portsOfCall.description: A final peaceful sea day as Queen Elizabeth makes her way home to Seattle.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Coastal

portsOfCall.description: Return to Seattle — disembarkation day after a grand 10-night Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

reviewSnippet: "No ship makes Alaska feel as grand as Queen Elizabeth. White-glove afternoon tea in the Queen's Room while Glacier Bay passed outside the windows — it was the most civilized, magnificent moment of our lives at sea." — Verified Guest
